notes: Built from the build sheet docs/ship_pipeline/build_sheets/voidsworn_S9/ (design file tools/blender/build_sheets/ships/voidsworn_S9.py; issue 1156). The sheet is the one home of the design (RULEBOOK 0.9, R225): masses, parts, mounts, seams, insides, hard points and the ship length (LENGTH 6.5, the Frigate class length) come from it through tools/blender/build_sheets/contract.py; this file only names the sheet, the game ids, the concept and the recipe settings. game_code V14_23 is the Frigate folder the game picks for voidsworn (godot/render/hull_table.gd AI_HULLS); an install replaces the old A4 hull there, copied aside first. bake stack: stage 5 paints it with the Sunward kit's paint stack (tools/blender/kits/voidsworn/stack.py, through tools/blender/r209/bake_sheet.py), the approved worn-metal satin finish; the colour zones are the sheet's. The concept was accepted by Ryan on Nov 19 2026 14:26 UTC with smaller spires (R331); concept_beauty.jpg is warden_beauty.webp from contrib/muse/design/class_family_sunward_2026_11/ as a jpg.
